title: Decree No. 10 of 2020 Concerning the Extension of the State of Emergency
text:
Decree No. 10 of 2020

 Concerning the Extension of the State of Emergency

 The President of the State of Palestine
 

 The Chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organisation
 

In reference of the Bylaw of the Palestine Liberation Organisation,

The Amended Basic Law of 2003, as amended, particularly the provisions of Title VII thereunder,

Having reviewed the Presidential Decree No. 9 of 2020 Concerning the Declaration of the State of Emergency,

The Law by Decree No. 7 of 2020 Concerning the State of Emergency,

In light of the extraordinary circumstances which the homeland is experiencing,

In pursuance of my constitutional duties of fully catering for the interests of the Palestinian people,

Based upon the powers vested in me, and 

In pursuance of the public interest,

 I hereby promulgate the following Decree:
 

 Article 1

The state of emergency shall be extended for a period of thirty days throughout the Palestinian territory in order to confront the ongoing outbreak of the coronavirus (COVID-19).

 Article 2

The competent authorities shall continue to take all the measures necessary to address the risks resulting from the outbreak of COVID-19, protect public health, and achieve security and stability.

 Article 3

The Prime Minister shall be authorised with the powers and competences necessary to achieve the purposes of this Decree.

 Article 4

All the competent authorities, each one within its sphere of jurisdiction, shall implement the provisions of this Decree, which shall enter into force as of October 4th, 2020, and shall be published in the Official Gazette.

 Promulgated in the city of Ramallah on October 2nd, 2020 Anno Domini,
 

 Corresponding to Safar 15th, 1442 Anno Hegira.
 

 Mahmoud Abbas
 

 President of the State of Palestine
 

 Chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organisation
